english.title: Post / distribute / display at Stansted Airport London a sign / advert / circular / matter for commercial purposes
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without the prior permission of the Airport Company

(A)_[posted]_
(B)_[distributed]_
(C)_[displayed]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Stansted Airport London

(D)_[signs]_

(F)_[circulars]_

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(14) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This Byelaw describes an act which is prohibited unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
